display_name: Retail — Kirana & General Daily Provisions Store
overview: Essential groceries, staples, packaged FMCG goods, dairy packets, toiletries, and dry rations. Characterized by high daily footfall, small ticket sizes (Rs. 50 to Rs. 800), rapid inventory turn (12-20 days), and customer credit via physical khata ledger books. Key financial drivers are daily cash/UPI sales volume and supplier distributor payment cycles.
red_flags_json: Significant customer ledger credit with no regular recovery cycle or mounting bad debts
Distributor supply halted or shifted to cash-only due to dishonored cheques
Stated turnover completely inconsistent with visible shelf stock during shop visit
Lack of basic refrigeration for dairy/perishable items leading to product wastage
